$comment: Endpoints in crates/xdk/vendor/x-api-openapi.json that have no shortcut command, and what xr decided for each. An operation is "METHOD /path"; METHOD may be *, and a path ending in /** also covers every path below it. status is raw-only or not-supported (no command, until revisit_when fires: never, github-pr-merged with repo and number, or crate-published with crate) or planned (a command family to build; it takes no revisit_when, and the entry is removed when the command ships). crates/xdk/tests/endpoint_decisions.rs holds every entry to the spec and the shortcut list, and fails for a spec operation with neither; scripts/endpoint-decisions.sh marks covered operations in a spec-refresh PR and reports fired triggers daily.

decisions.reason: XChat conversations are end-to-end encrypted: sending and reading them needs the conversation keys and message signatures that X's chat-xdk-core library handles, and that library is unpublished. Raw mode still reaches the endpoints.

Joining a call hands out a single-use, two-minute token for a real-time PCM16 audio WebSocket that xr does not drive, and starting one makes an empty call that xr calls scheduled add already provides. X marks the Calls API as in development. Raw mode still reaches the endpoints.
No xr activity family: raw mode covers the subscription endpoints and streams /2/activity/stream like every stream the spec declares.
Raw mode streams every stream the spec declares (xr -s <path>), one JSON line per event; a command would add nothing a pipe does not.
The same shapes as recent search and counts over all time. A flag on xr search would select an endpoint, which the command grammar forbids; raw mode serves them.
The reposts of a post as post objects. Who reposted is the planned post-engagement command; these posts carry nothing more.
Reposts of your posts and an organization's affiliates are niche reads; raw mode serves them.
Downloads media from a legacy direct message as raw bytes; raw mode writes the body to a file.
Ticket buyers of a ticketed Space, readable only by its creator.

Project administration: bot accounts and their bearer tokens, batch compliance jobs, streaming connections, and the developer account. A command would print minted bearer tokens into transcripts; the developer console and raw mode serve these.
The spec document itself, which the spec-drift workflow fetches.
Who liked, who reposted, and which posts quote a post.
Up to 100 posts by id in one request, which turns the ids a bookmark folder lists into posts.
How many posts match a query per bucket over the last seven days, before paying for a search.
Impressions and engagement for your posts.

An xr lists family: create, update, and delete lists; add and remove members; a list's posts, members, and followers; your owned, followed, and pinned lists and memberships; follow, unfollow, pin, and unpin.
Look up users by id, or several by id or username in one request.
Search for accounts by keyword.
A user's own posts.
Extend the dm commands: start a group conversation, send into a conversation, read one conversation's history, read or delete one message, and block or unblock a user's direct messages.
xr stream rules list, add, remove, and counts for the filtered stream, with the endpoint's dry_run behind --dry-run.

Extend xr broadcasts: your broadcasts; broadcasts scheduled (list, get, add, update, remove, live), which takes a source from broadcasts sources; and broadcasts chat (history, send, remove a message, mute, unmute).
An xr spaces family for discovery: search, by id, by creator, and a Space's posts.
An xr notes family over X's AI Note Writer API: write, rate, and delete notes, find posts eligible for one, and list the notes you wrote. Using it needs enrollment in X's program.
Extend xr media: get one or several uploads by media key, and their analytics.
Trends for a place and your personalized trends, as two verbs.
News search and a story by id.
Community search and a community by id.
xr articles draft and publish for long-form X Articles; publishing asks first, like other outward actions.
